environment.execution_assertion: This script is intended to be run inside the project Docker container.

duplicate_detection.method: Exact numeric equality across all 25 coordinates; no rounding; Python tuple keys at stated dtype.

split_reconstruction.source: experiments/phase7b/split_indices.npz, independently checked against train_ensemble.py logic

definitions.full_precision_match: Native precision exact feature match against all train.npz rows.
definitions.baseline_training_match: Float32 exact feature match against all train.npz rows, matching the Baseline training script's input cast.
definitions.ensemble_training_match: Float32 exact feature match against the 28,000 saved Phase 7B training indices; excludes the internal dev set.
